items.q: Can I order online and pick up in-store?
items.a: Shopping with A&P Dispensary is simple, fast, and secure. Browse our curated selection of premium flower, vapes, edibles, and concentrates online, then place your order in just a few clicks. Whether you’re picking up in-store or checking out the latest drops, we make the process smooth and hassle-free.
Enjoy the convenience of premium cannabis delivered straight to you. A&P Dispensary offers safe, reliable, and discreet delivery so you can shop your favorite products without leaving home.

Once your order is confirmed, our trained team carefully prepares it for dispatch. Each item is securely packed, quality-checked, and handled with discretion to ensure freshness, safety, and compliance. Your order is then readied for pickup or delivery within your selected time window.

items.q: Do I need to know what I want before I visit?
items.a: You don’t need to know the exact product or strain you want. Even having a general idea can help.
No upselling, ever. Our budtenders are trained to help you find the right product, not the most expensive one.

items.q: What's the difference between THC and CBD?
items.a: THC is the cannabinoid most commonly associated with the intoxicating effects of cannabis. CBD is another major cannabinoid that is not generally intoxicating in the same way THC is.

items.q: How should I store my cannabis?
items.a: Proper storage keeps your cannabis fresh, potent, and flavorful. We educate customers on best practices, including airtight containers, cool and dark environments, and humidity control to preserve quality over time. A little care goes a long way in protecting your purchase.

items.q: How do I hear about new arrivals?
items.a: New arrivals, restocks, and staff picks, sent every couple of weeks, never more. You must be 21+ to subscribe. Unsubscribe anytime.
